CustomField.description: Optional. Length in months of each auto-renewal period when the contract states it. Renewal Date uses it to roll forward; when blank, Auto-Renewal contracts use the initial term (Contract End Date minus Contract Start Date) and Evergreen contracts use 12 months. Added Sep 2026.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Months in each auto-renewal period, if the contract states it. Leave blank to use the initial term (Auto-Renewal) or 12 months (Evergreen).
CustomField.label: Renewal Term (Months)
